title: [Perf][KV Offload] Select the canonical load path by fragment size

## Purpose

Fixes #57342.

With `canonical_layout`, CPU→GPU copies are submitted per mapped fragment, but `_select_swap_blocks_fn` picked the load path from the page size. A page ≥ 28 KiB whose fragments are smaller ended up on `cuMemcpyBatchAsync`, in exactly the small-copy regime #42212 moved to Triton.

This makes the selector look at the sizes that are actually submitted: page sizes for the direct layout, `run.fragment_size` for the canonical layout. body:
## Motivation

MiniMax-H3 denoise is **attention-heavy**: ~50 layers × ~38k packed tokens per step, all through `forward_varlen` with FlashAttention (FA3) today. [Sol-Attn](https://nvlabs.github.io/Sana/Sol-Attn/) is NVLabs’ training-free sparse attention kernel.

[Sol-Attn](https://nvlabs.github.io/Sana/Sol-Attn/) is a **training-free, on-the-fly sparse attention** method for video diffusion. It routes attention blocks by threshold during an online-softmax pass, without materializing a full proxy score map.

## Purpose

Resolves #43187.

`Qwen2MoeMLP.forward` / `Qwen3MoeMLP.forward` currently apply the shared-expert gate as `F.sigmoid(self.expert_gate(x)[0]) * out`, which dispatches three separate GPU kernels with two `[N, 1]` HBM-resident intermediates (the linear logits and the sigmoid of those logits).
